description: This file appears to be a shell script for testing the behavior of Git's diff-tree functionality with bogus or null SHA-1 objects. It contains test cases that create and compare Git trees with intentionally invalid or placeholder SHA-1s to verify how Git's diff and patch application handle such edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.
